6795.title: Updater requests discard configured proxy headers
6795.rootCauseOneLine: The app omits server-header configuration from the updater, whose version and package requests never merge those headers.

prReviews.verdict: Static root-cause match; closed and unmerged; not executed

6795.proposedFix: Pass configured server headers through to both updater requests while preserving the cache validator; maintainer review required for authentication behavior.
6795.caveats: Real updater HTTP paths reproduced twice with synthetic local gates; full enrolled-host server-upgrade/reconnect lifecycle not run. Reproduction source and exact observations are inline; raw artifacts are local-only per reports policy. No automatic PR because credential forwarding changes authentication behavior.
